verdict.rationale: Baseten's first-party docs say Model APIs support the OpenAI Chat Completions API and expose an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Existing clients such as LangChain's ChatOpenAI can switch by pointing `base_url` at Baseten, so no provider-specific code is needed, and Baseten Switch can route agent requests back to Anthropic or OpenAI. missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the compatibility holds in practice, and documentation of any compatibility deviations or edge cases (the Anthropic Messages support is labeled beta).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent switch to or away from this provider mid-workflow because it speaks the standard chat-completions API without provider-specific code changes

citations.quote: They support the OpenAI Chat Completions API and the Anthropic Messages API in beta, so you can use familiar client SDKs.
Because Baseten exposes an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, you can use LangChain's `ChatOpenAI` with `with_structured_output` by pointing `base_url` at Baseten
Call hosted models through an OpenAI-compatible API
route requests back to those providers
